hero.sub: Everything you need to get started: the five most important platforms in one place.

intranet.name: KdG Intranet
intranet.desc: The intranet is KdG's digital hub. Find news, announcements and direct links to all other platforms here. It's the place you open every day.
intranet.f1: Current news and announcements from the school
intranet.f2: Direct links to Canvas, TimeEdit and eStudentService
intranet.f3: Documents and messages from the programme

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.desc: Canvas is the heart of your programme. All course content, assignments, deadlines and lecturer feedback are here. Check Canvas daily.
canvas.f1: Course material and slides per subject
canvas.f3: Calendar with deadlines and exam moments

timeedit.name: TimeEdit
timeedit.desc: TimeEdit shows your personal class schedule and lets you reserve available rooms. Perfect for group work, self-study sessions or a quiet workspace between classes.
timeedit.f1: View and export your personal timetable

estudentservice.name: eStudentService
estudentservice.desc: eStudentService is your personal student file at KdG. Manage your enrolment, track your results and request official documents here.
estudentservice.f1: Grades and study results per course unit
estudentservice.f2: View enrolment contract and registration confirmation
estudentservice.f3: Request certificates: public transport, student status, ...
estudentservice.f4: Full overview of your study programme and ECTS credits

ects.name: ECTS Sheets
ects.desc: ECTS sheets describe each course unit in detail: what you learn, how you are assessed, and how many study points the course is worth. Essential for your study planning.
ects.f1: Look up learning objectives and content per subject
ects.f2: View assessment methods and exam regulations
ects.f3: Check study points (ECTS) per course unit

tip.label: Pro tip
tip.body: Set the intranet as your browser's homepage. From there you always have quick access to Canvas, TimeEdit and eStudentService — without ever having to remember a link.
